cage_life.about: How the pets move in the Cage. Each pet's kind picks a row in kinds. Names in friends, tag and chases can be an art id or a kind, so a new pet of a known kind (another bug, say) joins in with no code change.

words.about: One name for each part of a pet app; PET-WORDS.md explains them. The GitHub Goldfish reads this list and flags the retired names in pet repos. test/pet-words-test-20261009.mjs keeps it in step with PET-WORDS.md.

parts.means: the whole set: one repo, one pet and its app
the full window that opens when you double-click the pet: a web app or a Windows app
the small pet that sits on the Windows desktop above other windows
a short line that pops up over the pet; the pet talking
the small box that opens from the desktop pet so you can type to it
the still picture on the taskbar, a shortcut or a browser tab
the square where the pet sits inside its app

mood_key.about: What each mood means for every pet. {subject} and {needs} come from the pet's audit block; a pet can override any line with "moods" in its pet.json.
mood_key.idle: {Subject} was fine at my last check.
mood_key.alarmed: Found a lot of problems in {subject}.
mood_key.sad: I couldn't finish checking {subject}. My fault; I'll try again.

rounds.about: The Friendly Farmer's rounds (scripts/farmer-rounds-20261009.mjs). Daily: find new pet repos, take each pet's submissions from its pet.json, run the self-audits that are due, write status/pets-status.json, rebuild. Each pet audits itself on its cadence and day.

relations.about: Who tells whom what. state: now (works today), planned (in a plan or card), idea (suggested, not agreed). RELATIONS.md is generated from this.

carries.registry: who exists, and each pet's name, job, status, moods and lines
carries.status: a pet's mood and its one-line bubble
carries.card: a task left in a handoffs/ folder
carries.keys: which API keys a pet uses (never the key itself)
carries.shipped: what changed: new repos, new pets, status changes
carries.cue: a live trigger: a scene, a beat, a button

links.why: Every pet submits changes to its name, job, status, moods and lines through its own pet.json; the Farmer's daily round takes them.
The daily round runs each pet's self-audit on its day and writes its mood and bubble.
Every sick pet's need is listed on the Farmer's desk under Needs you.
The profile round keeps findastra/findastra matched to the repos on GitHub.
The Goldfish reads pets.json, the pet words and the profile style.
Account-wide problems go to the Farmer as cards.
File Master uses the pet words and file names.
New project folders on the PC become candidates.
An idea Astra says yes to becomes a new pet repo.
Code findings become worklist items.
A secret found in a repo becomes a checklist step.
An old or exposed key becomes a checklist step.
Cloud light APIs (Govee and others) need keys; API Fairy keeps the notes.
Quick chat uses an Anthropic key.
Data Dealer uses several service keys.
The Goldfish uses a GitHub token.
What the daily round saw change becomes draft portfolio updates.
Claude Bot's status feeds the Anthropic presence card.
A class or show starts its lighting scene.
A session pulls its track list.
Lights follow the track's beat (RGBee v3).
Stream Deck buttons switch scenes.
A Stream Deck button opens quick chat.
VR performance notes feed world build tasks.
GIFs Gif Giraffe makes go to the meme collection.
What File Master finds unprotected is what Backup Beaver should copy.

relations.private_rule: These pets' data never leaves the PC. Other pets do not read from them, and the self-audit checks only their repo files.
